# proxmox_sdn_ipam (Data Source)

Reads one staged SDN IPAM from `/cluster/sdn/ipams`. The API token is not exposed, only its fingerprint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_ipam" "app" {
  ipam = proxmox_sdn_ipam.app.ipam
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipam` (String) IPAM to read.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String)
- `id` (String) IPAM identifier.
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `section` (Number)
- `state` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)
